CustomField.description: Ranking field used to prioritize asset records. The rank is derived using a weighted combination of Record Type, Status, and date values. Lower-level digits represent recency (based on status date or created date).
CustomField.formula: CASE( RecordType.DeveloperName , "WO" , 10000000 , "NSP_Asset_Product" , 20000000 , /* WX/WA */ 90000000 ) /* 8-digits */ + CASE( TEXT( Status ) , "Active" , 1000000 , "Onboarding" , 2000000 , "Terminated" , 3000000 , "Backout" , 4000000 , 9000000 ) /* 7-digits */ + CASE( RecordType.DeveloperName , "WO" , ( NSP_Account_Status_Date__c - DATE( 1900 , 1 , 1 ) ) , "NSP_Asset_Product" , ( CreatedDate - DATETIMEVALUE( DATE( 1900 , 1 , 1 ) ) ) , /* WX/WA */ 990000 ) /* 6-digits */
CustomField.label: Rank
